items.title: Run Continuum Save
items.description: trigger the continuum save script now

action.popup: sh -lc '~/.config/tmux/plugins/tmux-continuum/scripts/continuum_status.sh; printf "\npress enter to close\n"; read -r _'

items.title: Show Continuum Options
items.description: show autosave interval, restore, and boot settings

action.popup: sh -lc 'for opt in @continuum-save-interval @continuum-restore @continuum-boot @continuum-boot-options @continuum-systemd-start-cmd; do tmux show-options -gqv "$opt" | sed "s/^/$opt /"; done; tmux show-options -g status; printf "\npress enter to close\n"; read -r _'

items.title: List Autosave Files
items.description: show resurrect files written by continuum autosave

action.popup:
sh -lc 'dir="$(tmux show-option -gqv @resurrect-dir)"; if [ -z "$dir" ]; then if [ -d "$HOME/.tmux/resurrect" ]; then dir="$HOME/.tmux/resurrect"; else dir="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/tmux/resurrect"; fi; fi; dir="$(printf "%s" "$dir" | sed "s,\$HOME,$HOME,g; s,\$HOSTNAME,$(hostname),g; s,~,$HOME,g")"; if [ -d "$dir" ]; then ls -lah "$dir"; else printf "No resurrect directory yet: %s
" "$dir"; fi; printf "
press enter to close
"; read -r _'
